intuition_en: 20h VWAP deviation: how far current price is from the 20-hour volume-weighted average price. Positive = price above VWAP.
intuition_zh: 20小时VWAP偏离：当前价格偏离20小时成交量加权均价的程度。正值=价格高于VWAP。
expected_direction_explanation_en: Conditional direction: price above VWAP can mean either bullish continuation or mean-reversion opportunity, depending on regime.
expected_direction_explanation_zh: 条件方向：价格高于VWAP可能意味着看涨延续或均值回归机会，取决于市场状态。
known_limitations_en: VWAP deviation conflates trend and mean-reversion signals. Direction regime-dependent.
known_limitations_zh: VWAP偏离混合了趋势和均值回归信号。方向取决于市场状态。
horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 20 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
